44316.desc: Only this hammer has the power to solidify Umbala honey with a single blow, so no one can take it away anymore. However, be careful with your fingers!

44318.desc: A fragment of the soul of an Astral Spirit. Gather them all to unleash the power of the Astral Spirits with the help of an Fairy.

44319.name: Astral Spirit Core
44319.desc: One of many cores of an Astral Spirit, a part of its heart, so to speak, but completely useless without the soul...

44320.desc: An object to seal the soul of an Astral Spirit within the core. However, it is very small, so more are needed to awaken an Astral Spirit!

44323.name: Hunter's Badge (Binded)

45970.desc: This bait is particularly effective for catching rare fish and items. Each piece of bait lasts for 3 minutes and is capable of attracting various types of fish and items. However, please note that the bait may be bitten off by fish if you lose in the fishing game.

45971.name: Bloomcore

45977.desc: Kogarashi's Daily Quest Coin. You can exchange these coins for useful items at some Kogarashi NPCs.

45978.name: Kogarashi Monster Imperial Token
45978.desc: A token that is mostly used as currency in Kogarashi. It is usually dropped by monsters and can be exchanged for useful items at some Kogarashi NPCs.

45979.name: Soul of Kogarashi
45979.desc: Quest Item: A Captive Peaceful Soul, now rescued. It has experienced much pain and suffering. Can be dropped by any monster in the Kogarashi Pass when holding the corresponding quest. It is bound to the character. In a party, each nearby party member also receives this item additionally if one picks it up. The quest must be active on the character!

45980.name: Heaven's Scale
45980.desc: Required to upgrade Royal items from +11 to +15. It's also needed at certain merchants to exchange for rare items.

45985.name: Bamboo Fur (Quest)
45985.desc: Soft fibers gathered from the wild creatures of the pass. At twilight, the fluff shimmers with a faint green glow-said to symbolize harmony with nature.

45986.name: Blossom Crest (Quest)
45986.desc: A circular badge engraved with a single sakura petal. Once worn by shrine guardians, it now stands for silent courage and fragile beauty.

45987.name: Cronicle of the Warrior - S1 (Quest)
45987.desc: Day 1 - At the Edge of the Forgotten Wind: I have arrived at the path locals whisper about - the Kogarashi Pass. The torii gates are half-sunken, the earth beneath cracked with time. A stillness blankets everything. Even the wind feels.. expectant.

45988.name: Cronicle of the Warrior - S2 (Quest)
45988.desc: Day 3 - Whispers Among Blossoms: The cherry trees still bloom, though no one remains to tend them. Petals fall like silent snow. I heard something today-a voice in the wind, ancient and distant, murmuring my name. I pressed on.

45989.name: Cronicle of the Warrior - S3 (Quest)
45989.desc: Day 5 - Beneath the Watcher's Gaze: I reached the cliff. The petrified dragon statue towers above all, its stone eyes ever-watchful. Legends say it once soared across these skies before it was sealed mid-roar by sacred rites. It feels... alive.

45990.name: Cronicle of the Warrior - S4 (Quest)
45990.desc: Day 6 - Shrine of the Silent Fox: Nestled deep within, a lone kitsune statue guards the old shrine. I placed an offering-dried rice and sake. That night, I dreamed of fire, war, and a girl standing beneath falling blossoms, weeping.

45991.name: Cronicle of the Warrior - S5 (Quest)
45991.desc: Day 8 - Ruins of the Crimson Pavilion: I stumbled across broken stone halls swallowed by vines. A battlefield once, judging by the rusted blades and scorched earth. Cherry trees grow from shattered walls-as if the land refuses to forget.

45992.name: Cronicle of the Warrior - S6 (Quest)
45992.desc: Day 10 - Voices Return: The wind now speaks clearly. It calls itself "Kogarashi" - an old spirit born of fallen warriors and withered time. It guided me to a tree older than the mountains, its roots pulsing with warmth.

45993.name: Cronicle of the Warrior - S7 (Quest)
45993.desc: Day 12 - The Burden of Memory: I uncovered carvings in the mountain: stories of betrayal, sacrifice, and hope. The spirit begged me to remember them, to carry their stories beyond this pass. I fear I'm forgetting my own name.

45994.name: Cronicle of the Warrior - S8 (Quest)
45994.desc: Final Entry - I Leave This for You: If you find these pages, know that Kogarashi Pass is more than a place-it is a memory, a scar, and a guardian. Turn back, or continue with reverence. The blossoms will guide you... if your heart is still.

45995.name: Crane of Silent Wishes (Quest)
45995.desc: A delicately folded paper crane of unknown origin. Legends say each one holds a silent wish from a wandering spirit, forever folded into its wings.

45996.name: Crimson Gate Shard (Quest)
45996.desc: A shard of crimson wood once part of a sacred gate. It hums faintly in your hand, as if remembering ancient vows sealed in war.

45997.name: Demon Stone Shard (Quest)
45997.desc: Dark and cracked, radiating a faint purple aura. This fragment is all that remains of a seal used to imprison a powerful oni long ago.

45998.name: Dragon Relict (Quest)
45998.desc: An amulet carved from petrified dragon bone. Those who carry it feel a surge of ancient strength-alongside the burden of its untold past.

45999.name: Elderbloom Branch (Quest)
45999.desc: A branch from a centuries-old cherry tree whose blossoms never wither. Often used in rituals of remembrance and spiritual guidance.

46000.name: Emberbranch (Quest)
46000.desc: A gnarled branch that glows red during the night. It is said to come from the "Flame Tree" that only bloomed during times of war.

46001.name: Foxfire Scroll (Quest)
46001.desc: A scroll inscribed with flickering characters that ignite on their own after nightfall. Said to contain the cunning words of the Kitsune, bound in old magic.

46002.name: Kogarashi Chest (Quest)
46002.desc: An old, moss-covered chest that only appears at the peak of dusk. The wind surrounding it whispers of forgotten treasures and hidden trials.

46003.name: Kogarashi Legend Stone (Quest)
46003.desc: A smooth, grey stone with faint carvings, polished by time and wind. Often found in sacred places where the breeze carries the voices of the past.

46004.name: Kogarashi Manor Key (Quest)
46004.desc: An ornate key forged from gilded bronze. The doors it unlocks creak like forgotten voices, waiting to be heard again.

46005.name: Kogarashi Sword (Quest)
46005.desc: A red-lacquered wooden training sword. Yet those who wield it feel echoes of true battle, as if the blade remembers more than it shows.

46006.name: Legacy Brush (Quest)
46006.desc: A writing brush adorned with golden filigree. It was once used to paint prayers onto maple leaves-many of which still drift through the pass on the wind.

46007.name: Lost Iron Shoe (Quest)
46007.desc: Worn and rusted, yet still whole. Said to have belonged to a wandering swordsman whose steed carried him through storms and spirits alike.

46008.name: Pumpkin Kernels (Quest)
46008.desc: Three dried seeds, each etched with a tiny charm. Often left in forgotten shrines as offerings-or as small wards against hunger.

46009.name: Sentinel Scope (Quest)
46009.desc: An old telescope with surprisingly clear vision. Once used by a mountaintop guardian to watch over the pass, it still points to hidden paths.

46010.name: Spirit Flame Candle (Quest)
46010.desc: A tiny candle whose flame never wavers in the wind. It glows faintly blue whenever unseen spirits draw near.

46011.name: Strone Fang Relict (Quest)
46011.desc: A fossilized claw-shaped relic, heavy and cold to the touch. Believed to be from an ancient beast that once prowled the mountain shadows.

46012.name: Wolfshead Relict (Quest)
46012.desc: A roughly carved talisman made of dark wood. Wolves avoid it-as if sensing the presence of an ancient alpha spirit sealed within.

46013.name: Heaven's Force
46013.desc: Required to upgrade Royal items from +11 to +15. It's also needed at certain merchants to exchange for rare items.

46020.name: Lucky Pets Box
46020.desc: Contains a random monster as a Pet and many more from Kogarashi and Celestara! Good luck!

46026.desc: Converts a Royal weapon into a STR-Omega. On two-handed weapons, the scroll can be used twice to create a purple Upgraded Omega (only with the same scroll). Weapon Levels by killing Royal Level 10+ monsters. Max. Lv. Effects: STR +100, CD +30%, PvE +25%, ATK +20%. Multiple scrolls can be exchanged for a different one at Lui in Flaris.

58763.name: Scroll of Armor Merge (Soulreaver)
58763.desc: This Scroll can be used to merge a Black Shiny Part and a Destroyed Soulreaver Part into an equippable, soul-linked Soulreaver part. All stats remain.

58764.name: Scroll of Soulreaver Unbinding (Set)
58764.desc: This scroll unlocks a soul-linked Soulreaver Item.

58765.name: Scroll of Weapon Merge (Soulreaver)
58765.desc: This scroll can be used to merge a Black Shiny Part and a Destroyed Soulreaver Part into an equippable, soul-linked Soulreaver part. When merged, all stats, including the fused weapon, are preserved.

58766.name: Scroll of Soulreaver Unbinding (Weapon)

58767.name: Scroll of Bonus Stat-Reroll (Soulreaver Weapon)
58767.desc: With this scroll you have one try to change the bonus on a Soulreaver Weapon. The bonus is randomized. If the bonus doesn't change, you recieved the same bonus as the previous one! There is a very small Chance that the Scroll gets Destroyed!

58768.name: Scroll of Bonus Stat-Reroll (Soulreaver Equipment)
58768.desc: With this scroll you have one try to change the bonus on a Soulreaver Equipment Part. The bonus is randomized. If the bonus doesn't change, you recieved the same bonus as the previous one! There is a very small Chance that the Scroll gets Destroyed!

58769.name: Scroll of Bonus Stat-Reroll (Soulreaver Two-Hand Weapon Fusion)
58769.desc: With this scroll you have one try to change the bonus on a Soulreaver Fusion Weapon or to add a bonus. The bonus is randomized. If the bonus doesn't change, you recieved the same bonus as the previous one! There is a very small Chance that the Scroll gets Destroyed!
